Augments the tabletop card game Dixit with LLMs and other AI technologies to support inclusive play, matching the criterion of tabletop games combined with generative AI.

The study involves students designing tabletop game prototypes while integrating generative AI tools (ChatGPT, DeepSeek, Stable Diffusion), satisfying the criterion of combining tabletop games with generative AI.
The paper uses LLMs to generate content (spells) for the tabletop role-playing game Dungeons & Dragons, directly matching the combination of tabletop RPG and generative AI/language models.
